news.headline: Purpose-Built Materials Management Software for Transportation Agencies
Why Counties Are Replacing Spreadsheets with Road Construction Software

paragraphs: ExeVision sells project development software for road and highway work to state and local transportation agencies. Offerings are split between state agency and local agency needs, including software for county road construction.

Agencies do not have to buy the whole thing, since each subsystem can be implemented independently. A contractors exchange carries bidding communication between agencies and contractors and aims to improve bid accuracy. Inspectors record daily reports and inspections on a tablet, with or without an internet connection. That field data syncs to the construction management subsystem once the connection returns.

The company says it has served transportation agencies, engineering firms and construction teams since 2005. The Wyoming Department of Transportation is quoted saying the relationship began in 2005 and has covered its preconstruction and construction divisions. ExeVision lists an address in South Jordan, Utah.
